child_tool_info.description: Retain exact supplied RNA secondary-structure topology and optionally evaluate that structure with ViennaRNA.
child_tool_info.instructions: Analyze the exact supplied dot-bracket structure. Supply one UTF-8 RNA feature input JSON with the original record key, optional labels/sequence, exact or uppercase_ascii normalization, structure, supplied origin and provenance, optional physical subject binding, and energy_mode. Nested .()[]{} is supported; crossing pairs are explicitly unsupported. No repair or partial pairing subset is inferred for invalid topology. Pair endpoints are zero-based nucleotide indices; unpaired intervals are half open. Retain every position, immediate nesting relationship, maximal stem and exposed hairpin, bulge, internal, multibranch and exterior region. Optional sequence permits RNA IUPAC; ambiguous pairs remain distinct and excluded from an explicitly unambiguous-pair denominator. An absent sequence is different from empty or length-mismatched sequence. energy_mode=none needs no ViennaRNA import and no model. energy_mode=viennarna_evaluate requires unambiguous ACGU, an explicit model and RNA.fold_compound(sequence, md).eval_structure(structure). This evaluates the supplied structure and does not search for or report an MFE. Nested alternative bracket tokens are converted only for energy evaluation with every pair/index retained. Preserve valid supplied topology when energy fails. Do not use the former pair-weight energy heuristic or assign a biological zipper label. Bind the selected Python executable and worker bytes plus known ViennaRNA distribution/module/extension identities; null identity fields mean unknown deployment. Select temperature, dangles, noLP, noGU, noGUclosure, special_hp, logML, min_loop_size, max_bp_span and Turner2004 or an exact supplied parameter file explicitly. This single-sequence model excludes circular folding, G-quadruplexes, cofolding and hard/soft constraints. Neither selected algorithm produces ensemble probabilities or uncertainty. Unknown uncertainty remains absent. Supply explicit descriptive calculation parameters separately from the native model. Native model or input changes require new selected execution; changing saved descriptive calculations does not. Declare exact input digests/sizes, native-result, complete stdout/stderr, and for energy modes model and effective-parameter outputs. Use the original compiled argv as an argument list, never shell text. Commission through launch and its configured local-compute child with 20 GiB RAM, 4 GiB scratch and no wall-time cap. Preparation reserves the original job; the child selects practical.job.start to execute it once. Resource changes, retries and subsequent investigation remain episode choices. Monitoring reads the original attempt; results acquisition captures its sealed bundle and uses separate deterministic native-output parsers and calculators. Request the numerical components and exact associations needed by the receiving episode. Native success, complete artifact capture and delivery of qualified requested values are distinct facts. This information grants no direct scientific execution operation to the root or receiving scientific episode.
child_tool_info.name: analyze_rna_secondary_structure_features
